items.title: Billionaire Investor Seth Klarman’s Top 5 Stocks: Would He Buy More Today?
items.summary: Seth Klarman's Baupost Group just revealed its five largest stock positions, and the list includes a little-known industrial distributor posting explosive earnings growth alongside household names bleeding on the front page. Reverse-engineering his logic reveals a portfolio built for a very specific payoff.

items.title: Canadian National Railway (TSX:CNR) Secures North America Access Deal With Union Pacific
